newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar closes stable in slow market.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar closes stable in slow market.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed virtually unchanged at 476.25/476.75 per dollar on Tuesday, compared with 476.25/476.60 per dollar on Monday, in slow, stable trading, dealers said.
"The market was fairly quiet. The spread remains tight and the Central Bank has not had to intervene," one said.
Dealers said the market was extremely slow in the afternoon and saw no reason for a sharp swing in the exchange rate Wednesday.
